additionalTables.purpose: The explicit retrieval preference follows its managed artifact across sharing, movement and deletion.
An immutable extraction checkpoint follows the exact original version. A surviving shared or moved version retains its checkpoints.
Local extracted text and citations follow their extraction checkpoint. Index removal leaves these available under the original version's authority.
The publication pointer and stage follow one exact source version. The delivery identifier is a generation witness. Queue and receipt authority remain with their existing ledgers.
